title: a KerML keyword the grammar accepts but this tool does not model
note: FOUND 2026-09-03, FIXED the same day. Twenty-one grammar-legal KerML keywords (`namespace`, `class`, `feature`, `step`, `connector`, …) map to no metaclass here. The mapper used to report `parse/unknown-keyword` and RETURN, dropping the declaration and its whole body with no trace of the text — the same code the parser emits for a misspelling, from a different stage. It is now its own code, `mapper/unsupported-keyword`, and the declaration is kept as an unparsed element whose source is re-emitted verbatim.
